ValidationRule.description: New requests start Pending and must name the requester and include a note.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending")), ISBLANK(Requested_By__c), ISBLANK(Proposed_Note__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A new request must be Pending and include a requester and a note.
